info.title: EDMN Admin App API
info.description: Admin App (staff only). Every admin API requires a TOTP-verified session; sensitive actions require fresh 2FA (step-up). Phase 1 exposes no financial mutation.

get.summary: Proactive alerts inbox (notifications.manage or settings.manage): rule inventory with open counts + open alert feed. Read-only; references only, no PII
Audit trail, newest first, keyset-paged (audit.view). No before/after values, IP or user agent

post.summary: Start TOTP enrolment (staff without an authenticator yet)
Verify TOTP for this session (required before any admin API)
Rotate the Admin App refresh token

installationId.description: Random per-installation id generated by the app and kept in secure storage.

get.summary: Account-closure requests: pending or decided (same permission as the web /admin/closures page)
Customer search by name/email/phone (customers.view). Masked contact data; read-only
Customer 360 for staff (customers.view): profile with masked contact data, counts, recent orders. Read-only
Executive KPIs and operational queues (read-only)
Protected deals by stage (deals.view)
Protected deal summary and timeline (deals.view). No locations, payout data or delivery codes
Disputes: open, assigned to me, or closed (disputes.manage)
Dispute with messages (internal notes included), evidence metadata, assignee and history (disputes.manage)

post.summary: Assign an open dispute to an eligible staff member (disputes.manage). Audited; no financial effect

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per logical request; retries reuse it and receive the original response (header Idempotent-Replayed: true).

post.summary: Add an INTERNAL staff note (never shown to the parties, no notification) (disputes.manage)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per logical request; retries reuse it and receive the original response (header Idempotent-Replayed: true).

get.summary: Active staff who may be assigned a dispute (holders of disputes.manage)
National ID (KYC) verifications by status (identity.view). No numbers or images
KYC case summary (identity.view): status, review trail. Never the number, its digits or the images
The signed-in staff member and effective permissions

post.summary: Register/refresh the push token of THIS staff installation (stores only; nothing is sent while the flag is off)

parameters.description: Unique per logical request; retries reuse it and receive the original response (header Idempotent-Replayed: true).

get.summary: Does THIS staff installation have a registered push token, and is sending enabled server-side
My staff sessions (admin web and Admin App)

delete.summary: Sign out one of my staff sessions remotely

get.summary: Orders, or shipments without a receipt confirmation (orders.view)
Order with seller orders, shipments, tracking events and status history (orders.view). No address or contacts
Returns monitoring queue by tab (returns.manage). Search by number; masked customer names; read-only
Return detail for monitoring (returns.manage): status, workflow state, next action; evidence counted, never embedded; read-only
Seller application: checklist, document metadata, status history (sellers.view). No IDs, contacts or payout data
Seller applications awaiting review (sellers.review)
Support ticket queue by tab (support.manage). Masked requester names; read-only
Support ticket thread for staff (support.manage): ticket + full message history, masked author names, attachments flagged not exposed. Read-only

post.summary: Reply to a support ticket as the support team (support.manage). The customer sees a staff reply and is notified via SUPPORT_REPLY; never internal, never closes the ticket; audited without the reply body

post.description: Requires customers.manage (customer accounts) or roles.manage (staff accounts), fresh 2FA and a reason. Audited.

installationId.description: Random per-installation id generated by the app and kept in secure storage.

id.description: Opaque session handle (not the session secret).

refreshToken.description: Single use. Store only in Keychain/Keystore. A reused refresh token revokes the session.

bearer.description: Admin App access token (ADMIN_MOBILE session, 10 minutes).
